label: Representation invariants audit
title: Which existing ECA claims survive complement conjugation and reflection?
kind: Exact audit of six existing claims against two declared transformations
summary: Reflection preserves the commutator classification, derivative-observation closure, and all 4,608 local-cap budgets. Complement conjugation preserves closure, makes the native commutator covariant for exactly the 16 self-dual rules, and shifts cap radii beyond the frozen bound, which was wrong. Regime labels are 95% and 94% stable on the sampled sweep.
takeaway: The commutator's dependence on the 0/1 convention is exactly self-duality, and transporting the derivative as a state removes it. A frozen radius bound failed and its correction is post hoc.
